scope: Concrete public encode_slice equality, baseline versus measured pairs-unroll8-exact candidate, for all inputs with the same arbitrary AsRef callback, all output slices, and engines with equal encoding tables, padding symbols, and padding flags. Preserves returned byte count, sole API error, full returned buffer, and modeled failure/divergence. Error constructor names are translated losslessly. Native compilation, panic payloads, and state after caught Rust unwinding are not certified.
remaining: Native compilation is not certified; LZ4 optimization and full block equivalence remain separate unfinished work.
extraction: Concrete public models extracted with extract-base64-public.sh unroll8; this verifier can reuse existing models after checking source-copy identity. LLBC, model, source-copy and proof hashes are recorded.

benchmark_evidence.scope: Eight selected official encode_slice workloads; aggregate speedup is not a 2x gain on every workload. Recorded runs are audited; this verifier does not run new timings.

decoder_note: Opaque decoder declarations occur in the concrete Engine record and therefore in Lean dependency reports; no equality or behavioral hypothesis about decoding is used.
